description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the performance metric "Recall@10" across four different model configurations. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled from left to right as "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", with the text tilted slightly. The vertical value axis represents the score on a linear scale, ranging from a minimum of 0.1 to a maximum of 0.4, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. The chart consists of four individual bars that are not sorted by height. The first bar, labeled "Ours", is visually emphasized in orange and represents the tallest value at approximately 0.35. The remaining three bars are colored blue. The "- critiquing" bar reaches an approximate value of 0.29, followed by the "- scoring" bar, which is the shortest in the chart with a value of roughly 0.17. The final bar, "- ranking", has an approximate value of 0.23.
